headlines.title: Chili’s customers suffer burns after sipping margaritas mistakenly made with cleaning agent
headlines.description: A Chili’s Grill & Bar in North Carolina is back in business after three customers and two workers suffered chemical burns on their mouths from sipping margaritas mistakenly made with a cleaning chemical last week.

headlines.title: The state of the U.S. economy ahead of the midterms in five charts
headlines.description: On Election Day, Americans will answer the question of whether they’re better off than they were two years ago when they cast ballots in the midterms.

headlines.title: Best Travel Deals to Snag Before the End of the Year
headlines.description: Whether you’re looking to escape the cold or embrace the holiday season, travel expert Mark Ellwood joins TODAY to share all the best deals and getaway destinations, including Mystic, Connecticut, Cabo San Lucas, Mexico, Lutsen, Minnesota, and more.

headlines.title: Celebrate Election Day and Veterans Day With These Freebies
headlines.description: From free pizza on long voting lines to free admission to all national parks for veterans, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with a roundup of ways to cash in on freebies for the month of November.

headlines.title: Market drop wipes out more than a trillion dollars in value
headlines.description: As investors worry about massive spending on the A.I. buildout paying off, earnings reports drove markets down. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports on what happened on Wall St. and the hack on crypto exchange Binance.

headlines.title: Tech Stocks Plummet; Hackers Steal Over $6B in Cryptocurrency
headlines.description: Wall Street will be looking to bounce back after a very tough day for tech companies on Thursday that saw shares of Amazon, Intel and Google’s parent company Alphabet plummet. It comes as the crypto industry suffered the biggest heist in history with hackers making off with nearly $6 billion in cryptocurrency. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Binance says user funds are safe after thieves make off with billions in record hack
headlines.description: A record-setting cyberattack targeting the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange has rocked the digital assets industry.

headlines.title: Tech stocks wipe out $1 trillion in value as concerns deepen about the AI boom
headlines.description: Tech stocks plunged, wiping out $1 trillion from Nasdaq 100 index companies.

headlines.title: Affording America: For a traveling carnival, rising costs mean a bumpy ride
headlines.description: Blake Huston is a third generation carnival operator who has been around the business all his life. But rising gas, labor and insurance costs are all taking a toll on his bottom line and threatening the industry he calls a way of life.

headlines.title: ExxonMobil and Chevron report blowout profits as Trump touts benefits of high oil prices
headlines.description: The two largest U.S. oil companies, ExxonMobil and Chevron reported blowout profits as oil prices remain sharply elevated due to the U.S. war with Iran.

headlines.title: Binance targeted in $6.3 billion crypto heist, the largest ever
headlines.description: The company has suspended all deposits and withdrawals while it works with law enforcement to secure its infrastructure and locate stolen funds.
